title.zh-CN: 推荐系统如何学会“说出答案”：20 篇论文读懂生成式推荐
title.en: How Recommender Systems Learned to Say the Answer: Generative Recommendation in 20 Papers

subtitle.zh-CN: 从 BPR 的打分器，到 OneReason 的推荐推理
subtitle.en: From BPR’s scoring function to OneReason’s recommendation reasoning

question.zh-CN: 推荐系统从“给所有商品打分”，是怎样一步步变成“直接生成商品、列表，甚至推荐理由与思考过程”的？
question.en: How did recommender systems evolve from scoring every item to directly generating items, lists, explanations, and even an explicit reasoning process?

description.zh-CN: 先学会比较商品，再学会理解行为发生的顺序。
description.en: First learn to compare items, then learn that behavior has an order.

label.zh-CN: LLM 支线：把推荐写成语言任务
label.en: The LLM branch: recommendation as language

description.zh-CN: 统一任务、迁移知识，也暴露语言能力与偏好理解之间的鸿沟。
description.en: Unify tasks and transfer knowledge—while exposing the gap between language fluency and preference understanding.

label.zh-CN: Semantic ID 支线：直接生成商品
label.en: The Semantic ID branch: generate the item itself

description.zh-CN: 从生成文档 ID 到设计推荐 tokenizer，商品第一次真正成为可解码的 token。
description.en: From generating document IDs to designing recommendation tokenizers, items become decodable tokens.

label.zh-CN: 工业汇合：统一、规模化与推理
label.en: Industrial convergence: unification, scale, and reasoning

description.zh-CN: 两条路线在超长序列、统一召排、工程约束和推荐推理中汇合。
description.en: The two branches meet in long histories, unified retrieval-ranking, deployment constraints, and recommendation reasoning.

title.zh-CN: 推荐系统原本是一台打分机
title.en: Recommender Systems Began as Scoring Machines

role.zh-CN: 从隐式反馈、正负样本和 pairwise loss 开始，建立传统推荐的基本范式：学习 s(u,i)，然后排序。
role.en: Start with implicit feedback, positive–negative pairs, and pairwise loss to establish the classical paradigm: learn s(u,i), then rank.

title.zh-CN: 用户不是一个点，而是一段正在发生的故事
title.en: A User Is Not a Point, but a Story in Motion

role.zh-CN: 用户兴趣会变化，于是推荐第一次认真建模行为顺序。
role.en: Preferences change, so recommendation begins to model the order in which behavior unfolds.

title.zh-CN: 历史很长，真正相关的可能只有几步
title.en: History Is Long, but Only a Few Steps May Matter

role.zh-CN: 用 causal self-attention 代替 RNN，解释注意力如何寻找与下一次行为相关的历史。
role.en: Replace recurrence with causal self-attention and let the model find which past actions matter for the next one.

title.zh-CN: 把商品当成词，把购物记录当成句子
title.en: Treat Items as Words and Shopping Histories as Sentences

role.zh-CN: Item ID 变成 token，行为序列变成句子，Cloze/MLM 正式进入推荐系统。
role.en: Item IDs become tokens, histories become sentences, and Cloze-style masked modeling enters recommendation.

title.zh-CN: 所有推荐任务都能改写成一句话吗？
title.en: Can Every Recommendation Task Be Rewritten as a Sentence?

role.zh-CN: 把评分、序列推荐、解释生成统一成 text-to-text，推荐不再只有一个任务头。
role.en: Unify rating, sequential recommendation, and explanation as text-to-text instead of separate task heads.

title.zh-CN: 一个模型承包召回、排序、解释和创作
title.en: One Model for Retrieval, Ranking, Explanation, and Creation

role.zh-CN: 从学术统一走向工业 foundation model：prompt tuning、开放任务与推理效率。
role.en: Move from academic unification toward an industrial foundation model through prompt tuning, open tasks, and efficient inference.

title.zh-CN: 通用 LLM 并不天然懂“喜欢”
title.en: A General-Purpose LLM Does Not Naturally Understand “Preference”

role.zh-CN: 解释语言能力与推荐能力之间的 domain gap，以及 LoRA/SFT 为什么有用。
role.en: Expose the domain gap between language competence and recommendation competence, and explain why LoRA/SFT helps.

title.zh-CN: 上下文放得下，不等于模型看得懂
title.en: Fitting in Context Does Not Mean the Model Understands It

role.zh-CN: 长行为序列直接塞进 prompt 反而可能更差；引出行为检索和相关历史筛选。
role.en: Long histories placed directly in a prompt may hurt, motivating behavioral retrieval and relevant-history selection.

title.zh-CN: 世界知识与协同行为怎样合体？
title.en: How Do World Knowledge and Collaborative Behavior Meet?

role.zh-CN: 传统推荐器懂共现，LLM 懂商品语义；这一篇讲两种表示空间如何对齐。
role.en: Classical recommenders know co-occurrence and LLMs know semantics; this paper aligns the two representation spaces.

title.zh-CN: 如果检索不再查索引，而是直接生成 ID
title.en: What If Retrieval Generated IDs Instead of Looking Them Up?

role.zh-CN: 生成式检索的祖先：把 doc ID 当成输出 token，直接学习 P(ID|query)。
role.en: The ancestor of generative retrieval: make document IDs output tokens and learn P(ID|query) directly.

title.zh-CN: 给每件商品一串有语义的门牌号
title.en: Give Every Item a Semantic Address

role.zh-CN: RQ-VAE、Semantic ID、逐 token 解码，以及语义 ID 为什么有利于大规模检索和冷启动。
role.en: Introduce RQ-VAE, Semantic IDs, token-by-token decoding, and their benefits for retrieval scale and cold start.

title.zh-CN: Top-K 不是唯一答案，推荐列表也能逐个写出来
title.en: Top-K Is Not the Only Answer: A List Can Be Written Item by Item

role.zh-CN: SVD 子 ID、Next-K generation，以及生成整个列表为什么能优化多样性等整体目标。
role.en: Use SVD sub-IDs and Next-K generation to optimize list-level objectives such as diversity.

title.zh-CN: 语义上相似，不代表同一群人喜欢
title.en: Semantically Similar Does Not Mean Liked by the Same People

role.zh-CN: 区分 language semantics 和 collaborative semantics，并介绍量化编码与对齐任务。
role.en: Separate language semantics from collaborative semantics through quantized codes and alignment objectives.

title.zh-CN: 一个好 ID，必须懂内容、共现和均衡
title.en: A Good ID Must Understand Content, Co-occurrence, and Balance

role.zh-CN: 深挖生成式推荐最核心的 tokenizer 问题：层次语义、协同正则和 codebook 塌缩。
role.en: Examine the tokenizer problem through hierarchical semantics, collaborative regularization, and codebook collapse.

title.zh-CN: Tokenizer 不该只是离线前处理
title.en: The Tokenizer Should Not Be Merely Offline Preprocessing

role.zh-CN: Tokenizer 与推荐模型联合优化，讲清双重对齐目标和 alternating optimization。
role.en: Jointly optimize the tokenizer and recommender through dual alignment objectives and alternating optimization.

title.zh-CN: 推荐模型也存在 Scaling Law 吗？
title.en: Do Recommender Models Have Scaling Laws?

role.zh-CN: Meta 将推荐重写为 sequential transduction，讨论超长行为、工业效率与规模化。
role.en: Meta reframes recommendation as sequential transduction and studies long histories, industrial efficiency, and scale.

title.zh-CN: 召回和排序，能否由一个模型一次完成？
title.en: Can One Model Retrieve and Rank in a Single Pass?

role.zh-CN: Session-wise generation、Sparse MoE、DPO，把 retrieve–rank 多阶段管线统一起来。
role.en: Use session-wise generation, Sparse MoE, and DPO to unify the multi-stage retrieve–rank pipeline.

title.zh-CN: 传统交叉特征真的应该全部扔掉吗？
title.en: Should We Really Throw Away Every Traditional Cross Feature?

role.zh-CN: 对纯序列生成路线提出工程反思：保留 DLRM cross features、用户级压缩与部署成本。
role.en: Challenge the pure generation route with DLRM cross features, user-level compression, and deployment cost.

title.zh-CN: 推荐也需要先想后答吗？
title.en: Should Recommenders Think Before They Answer?

role.zh-CN: Item–text alignment、推荐 CoT、偏好奖励，推荐开始尝试显式、可控的推理。
role.en: Combine item–text alignment, recommendation CoT, and preference rewards to pursue explicit, controllable reasoning.

title.zh-CN: 看起来会思考，不代表真的懂偏好
title.en: Looking Like Reasoning Does Not Mean Understanding Preference

role.zh-CN: 用 perception 与 cognition 重新审视推荐推理，为系列留下真正开放的问题。
role.en: Reframe recommendation reasoning as perception plus cognition and leave the series with a genuinely open question.
